title: Rust source capture: validate complete bounded warning stderr without silent transport truncation
outcome: Rust source measurement accepts the agreed complete bounded slow-warning stderr contract and refuses unsupported or oversized producer output through the real native transport, preserving strict probes and source identity checks.
acceptance: The source-command transport on Windows and Unix captures complete stderr through 262144 bytes or reports bounded overflow; a valid 65536-byte warning prefix cannot hide unsupported, invalid UTF-8 or oversized tail content.

The Rust source measurement accepts status-0 valid envelopes with only supported complete warning lines, including valid streams above 64 KiB and at the agreed ceiling, retaining the diagnostic; malformed envelopes, pins, roots, source identities and status remain independent refusal gates.

Behavioral tests exercise the actual bounded-read transport and discriminate the status-0 gate; version/schema probes remain strict unless occurrence of the exact agreed warning is independently proven, and unrelated bounded-read callers retain their current behavior.
